s001: Mabel lies slumped and still, breathing slowly and shallowly, her half-closed eyes blinking once and one ear twitching weakly. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s002: The cat breathes slowly on the towel while the gloved hand eases the mask a little closer to its face; the cat stays limp. Slight handheld drift.
s003: Mabel breathes slowly under the towel, her eyes drooping heavier and blinking once; the drip line and her leg stay still. Very slow handheld push-in.
s004: The blurred view slowly pulls into soft focus on the bowl as the warm morning light shimmers gently; nothing else moves. Slow, steady handheld push-in.
s005: The gloved fingers hold the mouth steady while Mabel's tongue shifts slightly and her whiskers twitch; the gums stay in clear view. Subtle handheld drift, very slow push-in.
s006: Mabel holds her mouth wide open, her tongue curling slightly and her whiskers quivering, the swollen gums staying in clear view. Slow handheld push-in toward the teeth.
s007: Mabel's jaw trembles and her tongue flicks forward once, her nose wrinkling in discomfort while her mouth stays open. Handheld camera drifts slowly sideways to the left, no zoom.
s008: The woman slowly turns her face further away, nose wrinkling, lips pressed shut, while Mabel blinks and shifts on her lap. Gentle handheld drift.
s009: Mabel chews slowly and awkwardly on one side, tilting her head, and a biscuit drops from her mouth to the floor; the bowl stays still. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s010: Mabel stays crouched, eyes wide, shrinking back slightly as her ears turn sideways; the plate of food stays untouched and still. Low, slow handheld push-in.
s011: Mabel swats quickly at the reaching hand with her claws and nips at the fingers; the hand flinches back slightly. Slightly shaky handheld camera, no zoom.
s012: Mabel holds her hiss, ears pinned flat, her mouth opening a little wider as her whiskers pull back and her body tenses. Slight handheld shake, very slow push-in.
s013: Mabel stays frozen behind the cushion, her wide eyes darting once and her ears swivelling, then she sinks back slightly. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s014: The hand slowly strokes from Mabel's head down her neck while she keeps her ears flat, squints and ducks slightly away. Gentle handheld drift.
s015: The hand slowly moves the toothbrush closer and the black cat pushes it away firmly with its paw, turning its head aside. Gentle handheld drift.
s016: The woman rubs the finger brush gently along the cat's teeth as it squirms and twists its head away; her knees hold it steady. Slight handheld drift.
s017: The hand slowly tips the bottle and a thin trickle of liquid pours into the bowl, sending small ripples across the water. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s018: The scoop slowly tips and a few green biscuits tumble onto the pile and roll to a stop; the tray stays still. Gentle handheld drift.
s019: The black cat walks slowly away from the bowl toward the edge of the frame, tail swaying; the full bowl stays untouched. Steady handheld camera, slight drift.
s020: The scratched arm wiggles the toothbrush gently toward the ginger cat, which stays lying down, blinks slowly and turns its head away. Gentle handheld drift.
s021: The vet holds the cat steady and looks down at it gravely, lips closed, while the cat blinks and flicks an ear. Slow handheld push-in.
s022: The nurse leans in slowly and gently adjusts the cat's head while the anaesthetised cat stays limp, breathing slowly. Gentle handheld drift.
s023: Mabel slowly and stiffly climbs one step higher, pausing with her tail low like an old cat. Steady handheld camera gently follows upward.
s024: The vet nods gravely and gestures with one hand, lips closed, while the woman holds the cat closer and glances down. Slight handheld drift.
s025: The monitor lines sweep slowly across the screen and the numbers flicker; the draped cat rises and falls gently with each breath. Very slow handheld push-in toward the monitor.
s026: Mabel lies still beside the plate, blinking slowly, then lowers her chin onto her paws; the food stays untouched. Low, slow handheld push-in.
s027: The vet gently strokes the kitten with her thumb, lips closed, while it blinks and wriggles slightly. Gentle handheld drift.
s028: The vet holds her closed-lip smile and shifts the tabby slightly in her arms while it blinks and looks around. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s029: Mabel's yawn widens slowly to its fullest, her tongue curling, then her eyes squeeze shut as she begins to close her mouth. Slow handheld push-in.
s030: The drawer slides open a little further and the bags shift slightly; everything else stays still. Slow handheld push-in from above.
s031: The green chew rocks slightly on top of the tooth as saliva glistens; the tooth and gums stay still. Smooth slow camera tilt down toward the untouched gumline.
s032: The golden goo slowly oozes and settles over the teeth while the trapped bacteria pulse and drift inside it. Smooth slow lateral camera glide along the row of teeth.
s033: Water splashes over the tooth and streams off the hard brown crust, which stays completely unmoved. Smooth slow push-in toward the crust.
s034: The bacteria inside the plaque fortress wriggle and pulse while the tiny flag flutters gently on top; the stone blocks stay solid. Smooth slow camera arc around the fortress.
s035: The spiky bacterium saws its legs back and forth into the gum while the red blood cell drifts slowly away. Smooth slow push-in.
s036: The swollen red bacterium pulses brighter and grows slightly larger, its legs twitching; the fortress behind stays still. Smooth slow camera pull-back.
s037: The woman tips the bag and dry food pours steadily into the bowl, a few pieces bouncing out; her face stays calm, lips closed. Gentle handheld drift.
s038: The hand slowly stirs one bowl in circles with the spoon; the other bowls stay still. Gentle overhead handheld drift.
s039: The glossy saliva layer slowly flows upward over the tooth from the gumline, glistening as it spreads. Smooth slow camera rise from the gumline to the tip of the tooth.
s040: The tabby squirms and scrunches its face harder, pawing at the toothbrush and pulling its head back. Slightly shaky handheld camera, no zoom.
s041: The woman's thumb slowly strokes the cat's relaxed paws, which stay soft apart from a gentle toe flex. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s042: Mabel lowers her head and sniffs the food, whiskers twitching, then takes a first lick; the tub behind stays perfectly still, label sharp and readable. Very slight handheld drift.
s043: Mabel crunches her biscuits happily, jaw chewing steadily and ears relaxed, then dips in for another mouthful; the bowl stays still. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s044: The woman and Mabel slowly rub noses, Mabel's eyes half closing contentedly as the woman smiles with lips closed. Gentle handheld drift.
s045: Mabel kneads the pillow once and settles deeper, eyes slowly closing, while the woman smiles softly with lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s046: The hand gently strokes Mabel's back as she breathes slowly, her eyes closing contentedly and an ear twitching. Gentle handheld drift, very slow push-in.
s047: The fingers hold the lip gently while Mabel blinks calmly and her whiskers twitch; the pink gums stay in clear view. Slow handheld push-in toward the gums.
s048: The fingers lift the lip slightly higher to show more pink gum while Mabel stays calm and flicks an ear. Handheld camera drifts slowly to the right, no zoom.
s049: The fingers hold the mouth gently open while Mabel blinks calmly and her tongue shifts; the healthy gums stay in view. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s050: The woman hugs Mabel a little closer and nuzzles her cheek against her head, eyes and lips closed, while Mabel blinks slowly. Gentle handheld drift.
s051: Mabel rubs her cheek slowly along the woman's face while the woman smiles wider, eyes and lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s052: Mabel finishes her yawn and slowly closes her mouth, settling her head into the cushion with a contented ear twitch. Gentle handheld drift.
s053: The tub stays perfectly still, label sharp and readable, while a soft highlight glides slowly across its surface. Very slow, smooth push-in.
s054: The hand slowly turns the jaw model a few degrees, light gleaming across the white teeth. Gentle handheld drift.
s055: The hand tips the scoop and the powder falls gently onto the food in a soft dusting; the tub stays perfectly still, label sharp and readable. Very slight handheld drift.
s056: The cheerful green bacteria bob up and down and march slowly along the castle wall; the tooth and wall stay still. Smooth slow push-in.
s057: The brown bacteria shrink and pull away from the gum, which slowly turns less red; the tooth stays still. Smooth slow camera glide along the gumline.
s058: The brown plaque blobs slide slowly away from the base of the tooth and drift off; the tooth stays still and bright. Smooth slow push-in.
s059: The hand strokes slowly along the tabby's back while it stretches its paws and blinks contentedly. Gentle handheld drift.
s060: Mabel nuzzles slowly against the woman's face and the woman smiles a little wider, eyes and lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s061: The fingers hold the cat's mouth gently open while it blinks calmly and its whiskers twitch; the gums stay in clear view. Slow handheld push-in.
s062: The gloved hand slowly lowers the syringe toward the sedated cat, whose chest rises and falls gently with each breath. Gentle handheld drift.
s063: The instruments lie perfectly still on the drape while overhead light glints slowly across the steel. Slow handheld push-in.
s064: The drill tip moves slowly along the teeth in small, careful motions while the anaesthetised cat stays still, breathing gently. Gentle handheld drift.
s065: The black cat finishes its yawn, slowly closes its mouth and licks its lips, then blinks; the laptop stays still. Gentle handheld drift.
s066: The hand holds the tub perfectly steady, label sharp and readable, while the biscuits behind stay still. Very slow handheld push-in toward the tub.
s067: The hand rests on the tub, which stays perfectly still, label sharp and readable; the biscuits stay untouched. Very slow handheld push-in.
s068: The hand slowly lifts the scoop of powder out of the tub, a few grains falling back; the tub stays perfectly still, label sharp and readable. Very slight handheld drift.
